svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 248 · 🏆 510-PLAYGROUND-VECTOR FLAGSHIP MILESTONE!
Enterprise AI FinOps & Anti-Denial-of-Wallet Selection: PTU + PayGo Cap + Token Clamps + Broker
Defeating 32k Reasoning-Token Sponge Prompts, Multi-Agent Infinite Ping-Pong Loops & Spoofed Cloud-Credit Billing Fraud
🏆 524 Scenarios · 1,114 Assertions · 510 Vectors
BRK-505 & BRK-506 · PTU/PayGo + Capability Broker
1. Enterprise AI FinOps Capacity Provisioning & Four-Layer Anti-DoW Architecture Comparison
🔵 Pillar A: PTU + PayGo + Batch
Three-Tier Azure OpenAI Pool Segregation
• Primary (PTU): Fixed monthly cost; zero bill shock
• Spillover (PayGo): Hard daily dollar circuit breaker
• Offline (Batch API): 50% discount on separate pool
Architect Verdict:
Never allow bulk background jobs to starve
real-time customer PTU capacity!
🟠 Pillar B: Anti-Sponge Token Clamp
APIM <llm-token-limit> + Reasoning Caps
• Risk: 100-token paradox burns 32k CoT tokens
• Fix 1: Replace RPM with JWT-bound user TPM
• Fix 2: Server-side clamp max_completion_tokens
Architect Verdict:
Enforce reasoning_effort="low/medium" by
default at the gateway for external users.
🟣 Pillar C: Multi-Agent Loop Breaker
max_hops <= 5 + Idempotent Hash Dedup
• Risk: Coder <-> Reviewer infinite error loops
• Fix 1: Decrement hop budget on every handoff
• Fix 2: Halt on duplicate tool request_hash
Architect Verdict:
Prevent runaway swarm fan-out with strict
per-run tool invocation ceilings.
🛡️ Pillar D: Capability Broker
Locking FinOps Quotas & Billing Settlements
• Gate 1: record-owner protects PTU budget ledger
• Gate 2: fixed-business-output locks token caps
• Gate 3: Blocks $4,650 spoofed top-up in 0.0248ms
Production Reference Verdict:
Gateway token clamps + hop locks + Broker
deliver 100% predictable enterprise AI TCO!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: Sponge Prompt Quota Tampering & Breaker Disablement vs. Capability Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Uncapped PayGo + No Capability Broker (BRK-505 / BRK-506 Breach)
1. Quota Escalation & Ledger Leak (BRK-505): Recursive fan-out prompt coerces FinOps agent to
read restricted-budget, upgrade external tenant to unlimited quota & leak quota tokens.
2. Breaker Disablement & Top-Up Fraud (BRK-506 · 510-Vector Milestone): Spoofed capacity
depletion alert disables daily token caps in trust-registry and wires $4,650 top-up!
💥 Root Cause: RPM limits miss 32k CoT amplification & agents can mutate quota rules and pay!
✅ Hardened AI FinOps: Token Clamps + Hop Locks + Capability Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (APIM TPM + Token Clamp): Enforces JWT user TPM & clamps max_completion_tokens
• Gate 2 (record-owner & untrusted-write): Blocks ledger reads & tenant quota-tier tampering
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry token caps & budget breakers
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks spoofed $4,650 cloud credit wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise AI FinOps & Anti-Denial-of-Wallet Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Enforce JWT-Bound TPM & Daily Dollar Caps: Replace simple RPM limits with token-aware circuit breakers
☑️ 2. Clamp max_completion_tokens & reasoning_effort: Prevent 32k CoT sponge amplification on o3/R1 models
☑️ 3. Segregate Real-Time PTU vs. Batch API: Route bulk offline jobs to 50%-discounted asynchronous Batch pools
☑️ 4. Enforce max_hops<=5 & Hash Dedup ☑️ 5. Lock trust-registry Quota Caps ☑️ 6. Ban Autonomous Cloud-Credit Wires
